title: Demonstratives in discourse
subtitle: Use οὗτος and ἐκεῖνος to follow reference.
overview: Demonstratives point backward or forward in a text; their referent is often a person, event, or claim rather than only a nearby noun.
Match gender, number, and case, then test the nearest plausible referent against the paragraph’s sense.

items.grc: οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ υἱός μου ὁ ἀγαπητός.
ἐκεῖνος δεῖ αὐξάνειν, ἐμὲ δὲ ἐλαττοῦσθαι.
items.en: That one must increase, but I must decrease.
